goal: Complete the remaining #2998 pre-draw readiness checks (evidence pair, main currency, protected-source collision) and the pre-draw prompt contract, without reducing any review requirement.
dispatcher: Owner Albert Hazan authorized resolving open non-orchestrator GitHub issues in popcre/shared-db
prohibited_actions: No database write, migration, function, view, role, grant, index, or timeout change.
Do not reduce what a reviewer must check, make any verdict optional, or let a failed handoff read as an approval.
No edit to the shared checkout.
required_checks: node --test scripts/reviewer-draw-readiness.test.mjs scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.test.mjs scripts/run-governed-review.test.mjs scripts/agent-work-contract-git-evidence.test.mjs scripts/agent-work-contract.test.mjs scripts/merged-pr-issue-binding.test.mjs scripts/reviewer-wire-budget.test.mjs
assumptions: GitHub computes pull request mergeable asynchronously, so a null value must proceed rather than refuse.
The #3187 wire budget of 10 GitHub API requests per reviewer operation is preserved by sharing pre-draw reads and never caching across the post-mutex freshness re-read.
Existing assertReviewerDrawReadiness draft/conflict/closed-unmerged refusals are unchanged and still run on both draw paths.
stop_conditions: Stop and report if any change would need a schema or structure change, a database write, or a new migration.
Stop and report if any refusal would become a warning or a pass.
Stop and report if a required check cannot be made green without weakening a gate.
